issue.title: Auth + identity bootstrap
issue.body:
## Context

- Part of the mobile sync epic: #14 

## Background
No login flow for mvp. `userId` and `userEmail` are hardcoded in `.env`
and bootstrapped into MMKV on first launch. We then fetch the user record
from the server and write it into SQLite as the FK anchor for all subsequent
syncs.

## Tasks

### MMKV bootstrap
- [x] Read `USER_ID` and `USER_EMAIL` from `.env` at app startup
- [x] Write both into MMKV on first launch: `userId` (int), `userEmail` (string)
- [x] Wire `userEmail` into the existing request interceptor as the
      `x-user-email` header on all authenticated requests

### User identity fetch
- [x] Call `GET /users/email/:email` using `userEmail` from MMKV
- [x] Upsert the response into SQLite `users` table:

| Column | Source |
|--------|--------|
| `id` | response `id` |
| `username` | response `username` |
| `email` | response `email` |
| `first_name` | response `firstName` |
| `last_name` | response `lastName` |

## MMKV keys set here
| Key | Value | Set when |
|-----|-------|----------|
| `userId` | `00` | App startup |
| `userEmail` | `user@fluent.com` | App startup |

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Every authenticated API request carries `x-user-email` header
- [x] `userId` and `userEmail` are readable from MMKV immediately after app launch
- [x] `users` table has exactly 1 row after first launch
- [x] Re-running does not duplicate the row (upsert on `id`)

comments.body: Used op-sqlite KV Storage instead of mmkv.
